row.sso_plan: Oracle Fusion Sales Enterprise Cloud Service
row.evidence: Oracle's REST API for Common Features documents a SCIM Users resource 'used to create, update, delete, or view users in Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications' (/hcmRestApi/scim/Users), and the Fusion price list sells CX Sales as Sales Enterprise at $150.00 per named user with no separate SCIM SKU.
row.notes: New row. Pricing from Oracle's public Fusion Cloud Service Global Price List (Sept 10, 2026), linked from oracle.com/corporate/pricing: Oracle Fusion Sales Enterprise $150.00 per hosted named user per month, minimum 10, standard 3-year term (billing cadence not stated, so per-month list price used). SCIM is part of Fusion's common REST APIs (Users, Roles, Schemas, ResourceTypes, Bulk) with basic auth; it is not sold separately, so status is free with medium confidence (price list does not mention SCIM). Deprovisioning sets active=false (account suspended) or deletes. No SCIM Groups resource (Roles instead), so groups=false. SAML SSO via the Security Console or the Fusion OCI IAM identity domain (Oracle Apps type, included with SaaS). Okta has no first-party CX Sales app (Aquera's Oracle Cloud Applications connector only); Entra 'native' rests on the 'Oracle Fusion ERP' gallery app, which provisions to the same Fusion SCIM endpoint.

plans.name: Oracle Fusion Sales Enterprise Cloud Service
plans.price_text: $150.00 per Hosted Named User per month (minimum 10; standard 3-year term)
plans.notes: Only Sales base on the price list. 'Sales and Service Limited' ($25/named user, min 10) is listed as an option to the base, not a standalone tier (c35).

scim.plan: Oracle Fusion Sales Enterprise Cloud Service

auth.token_source: Fusion user account with security administration privileges (Security Console)

endpoints.notes: No Groups resource: Fusion exposes /hcmRestApi/scim/Roles instead, with PATCH on members.

deprovision.data_retained: Setting active=false suspends the user account (it remains, can be re-activated); DELETE /Users/{id} removes the user account.

custom.how: Oracle extension urn:scim:schemas:extension:fa:2.0:faUser: userCategory, accountType, partyInformation (partyNumber, PartyUsage), workerInformation (personNumber, manager, job, businessUnit, department), assignServiceAdminRoles. Customer-defined attributes are not documented.

group: Roles: id, name, displayName, description, category, members

roles.how: roles attribute on Users, and PATCH /hcmRestApi/scim/Roles/{id} members to add or remove role membership

limitations.text: No SCIM Groups resource; role membership is managed through the Roles resource.
Authentication shown is HTTP Basic with a Fusion user name and password.

scim.notes: SCIM API is part of the REST API for Common Features shared by all Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications (HCM, ERP, SCM, CX Sales) on the same pod. Its core schema URN is written urn:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User in Oracle's example (not the RFC 7643 urn:ietf:params form). No separate SCIM or identity SKU appears on the Fusion Cloud price list.

user_api.plan: Oracle Fusion Sales Enterprise Cloud Service

auth.notes: Basic auth as shown in the common Fusion REST examples; OAuth options were not checked.

endpoints.purpose: Delete a resource user (documented as Not Supported)

webhooks_user_events.notes: No push webhooks; the User Requests Atom feed (/hcmRestApi/atomservlet/user/userRequests) publishes user lifecycle entries.

limitations.text: Deleting a resource user is documented as not supported; the resource is only for CX Sales and B2B Service.

user_api.notes: api_tax false: the single Sales base SKU carries the REST APIs; no separate API SKU appears on the price list (inferred, not stated).

okta.notes: No Oracle Sales/CX Sales app in the OIN (search 'oracle', 2 pages). 'Oracle Cloud Applications by Aquera' creates, updates and deactivates users in Oracle Cloud Applications; third-party built.

entra.notes: Gallery app is named 'Oracle Fusion ERP' but targets the shared Fusion SCIM endpoint (/hcmRestApi/scim/) that also serves CX Sales users on the same pod. Basic auth only; no group provisioning; roles via Entra groups named after Fusion roles.

SCIM rate limits and maximum page size are not documented.
Whether OAuth/JWT bearer tokens are accepted on /hcmRestApi/scim is not stated on the SCIM pages (examples use basic auth).
